title: AI Mismatches: Identifying Potential Algorithmic Harms Before AI Development
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to proposing and evaluating a framework (AI Mismatch matrices) for the ethical assessment of AI systems. It explicitly centers on Responsible AI (RAI) and FATE (Fairness, Accountability, Transparency, and Ethics) research to identify and mitigate algorithmic harms and ethical risks during the early stages of AI development.
